home.title: HACKATHON: NASA SPACE APP
home.paragraph: Explore the fascinating dynamics of asteroids with our interactive simulator.

home-banner.title: Save the world or see what would happen in a catastrophic scenario
home-banner.paragraph: Like the universe, our imagination has no limits!

home-description.title: Simulation and research for everyone
home-description.paragraph: Asteroids simulation is here and it is a good opportunity to learn in an interactive way or travel in a unimaginable scenarios.

home-items.paragraph-asteroid-types: Asteroids like Carbonaceous, Stony, Metallic... Explore their diversity and impact magnitudes. View scenarios in 2D and 3D!
home-items.paragraph-public: Our app turns science into an engaging, interactive, and exciting experience. We want everyone to be able to join in and learn about space in a fun and easy way.
home-items.paragraph-api-nasa: It's a menu of services that an organization provides so you can use its information. NASA uses open APIs so anyone (scientists, students, developers, and just anyone interested) can create apps, visualizations, or simulations with real-world space data.

home-challenge.title: Test yourself with this challenge
home-challenge.paragraph: NASA shares their data and challenges with the world so teams or people like you can create creative solutions. Dare to put your skills to the test and be part of it. Let's combine science and technology to solve real-world problems. Now it's your turn to put your ingenuity to the test.

home-banner-2.title: Together with the team, we seek to take our audience to internalize the area of outer space and that great things are created from curiosity.
home-banner-2.paragraph: Like the universe, our imagination has no limits!

team.title: TEAM JJB
team.paragraph: We are Team JJBC — a group of three creators passionate about building interactive tools and simulators that make complex ideas easy to explore and understand.
